question: On one numerically isolated Secure RTX 5090 session, does changing only the CUDA F4 update-grid target from four to six blocks per SM improve the primary device stage by at least 2% with its simultaneous interval strictly above the same-session byte-identical A/A noise floor, without a >2% device or complete-stage holdout regression?

claims.text: The same-session byte-identical baseline and baseline-aa intervals contain one and resolve clock noise to at most two percent on every registered cell and metric.
claims.if_supported: each registered A/B clock is read against its corresponding symmetric same-session A/A noise floor
claims.if_not_supported: all measured clocks are wall_valid=false and the terminal timing outcome is invalid_measurement

claims.text: Baseline, baseline-aa, and candidate reproduce every registered matrix shape, rank, refuted result, pinned count, and word-operation count exactly; baseline and baseline-aa binaries are byte-identical.
claims.if_not_supported: the session is invalid and no timing or mechanism claim is admitted

claims.text: The six-block target improves primary k0n13m2d6 device-stage time by at least two percent and its simultaneous A/B interval clears the symmetric same-session A/A noise floor.
claims.if_supported: report a device-stage engineering speedup scoped to this exact session
claims.if_not_supported: do not retain the production candidate for performance

claims.text: The six-block target has no greater-than-two-percent complete-stage regression on any registered cell and no greater-than-two-percent device-stage regression on any non-primary cell.
claims.if_supported: the candidate passes the prospective non-regression family
claims.if_not_supported: the candidate is rejected even if the primary point estimate improves

claims.text: Nsys shows exactly the registered four-to-six-block update-grid transformation while launch order, all non-update geometry, and update resource use remain fixed.
claims.if_supported: the observed timing comparison has the registered mechanism
claims.if_not_supported: the session is invalid for the geometry claim

hypotheses.statement: More update blocks expose additional independent work on the primary matrix without changing arithmetic work.
hypotheses.mechanism: The update kernel remains at 256 threads, 31 registers per thread, 16 KiB static shared memory, and zero local bytes per thread; six blocks fill the RTX 5090's 48-warp per-SM limit when enough tiles exist.

predictions.minimum_effect: median paired baseline/candidate speedup >= 1.02 and simultaneous lower bound > 1 on k0n13m2d6

data_seen.measured: v7 baseline showed update as 51.7% of primary kernel time; no six-block candidate data existed

provenance.decisive_scope: all v10 rows are fresh; v7 selected the mechanism but supplied no candidate outcome

arms.description: The candidate commit build-closure archive with only suite/src/cryptanalysis/f4_gpu.rs overlaid from the retained v7 production commit, preserving the four-block-per-SM target.
A byte-identical copy of the constructed baseline instrument under the baseline-aa label, interleaved on the same pod to measure label/order clock noise in this exact session.

power.note: N=6 fixed same-round triples. For each of five cells and two clocks, form one A/B and one A/A median-ratio distribution: 20 two-sided interval cells and 40 Bonferroni tails at exact probability .05/(2*20)=1/800. Enumerate all 6^6 resamples with exact rational arithmetic and no RNG. Each A/A interval must contain 1 and its symmetric floor must be <=51/50; the primary A/B lower endpoint must strictly exceed that floor as well as the 1.02 point threshold.

preflight_runtime.measured_on: The retained v7 remote command completed in 226.551 seconds with 70 unprofiled rows and two traces. V10 conservatively budgets 5,400 seconds for two isolated builds, one fixed settle, 105 unprofiled fresh processes (15 excluded warmups plus 90 measured A/A+A/B rows), two Nsys traces, exact 20-interval analysis, export, and finalization. Frozen v8/v9 produced zero provider calls, pods, or rows.

measurement.timed_primary_justification: The optimization changes launch geometry while exact word_ops is invariant, so counts cannot measure scheduling or memory-latency effects. Clocks are evidence only for successful fresh-process rows that earn the frozen numeric tierB gate and whose byte-identical baseline/baseline-aa interval from this same pod contains 1 and lies within [50/51,51/50]. Primary A/B evidence must strictly clear the corresponding symmetric A/A noise floor.

placement.isolation_scope: same-pod paired instance scope; physical-host exclusivity is not asserted

stopping_rules.rule: Attempt exactly one fixed-order warmup and six measured fresh-process triples using all six label permutations once for every registered cell, followed by exactly one primary Nsys capture for baseline and candidate.
Stop and retain the session on any source, identity, correctness, isolation, process, profiler, archive, or cleanup gate failure; do not replace the pod or row.
The provider controller may create at most one pod and maximum cost exposure is USD 3.57.

invalidation_rules: Any missing, unreadable, truncated, failed, timed-out, nonzero-runner, nonzero-controller, corrupt-archive/export, missing completion marker, or unproved exact-ID cleanup evidence yields incomplete_session.
With completion established, any protocol/freeze/tool/argv/source/archive/overlay/scoped-diff/GPU/arm/request/pod/price/host/order/row/export/file identity mismatch yields invalid_measurement.
The baseline and baseline-aa binaries must be byte-identical; the candidate must differ, and the 105-row ledger must match the separate warmup plus all-six-permutations measured schedule exactly.
Any missing, duplicate, retried, resumed, failed, non-CUDA, wrong-answer, wrong-work, or wrong-order execution invalidates the session.

Any measured row with CPU PSI some avg10 >10, CPU PSI full avg10 !=0, memory PSI some/full avg10 !=0, a cgroup throttle/memory-event delta, a steal delta, GPU temperature >=90 C, a foreign GPU process, or malformed telemetry is invalid.
If any same-session A/A interval excludes 1 or extends outside [50/51,51/50] (symmetric floor >51/50), all measured wall_valid fields are false and the terminal clock verdict is invalid_measurement.
Any Nsys trace without exactly 2,941 ordered update launches, exact four-versus-six grid formula, identical non-update geometry, or exact update resources invalidates the session.
Any profile duration entering either A/A or A/B timing distribution invalidates the analysis.

decision_rule.text: First require complete evidence, exact identities/answers/work, numeric tierB isolation, and every same-session byte-identical A/A interval both to contain 1 and to lie within [50/51,51/50]. For every cell and each of device_ms and complete_ms, enumerate all 6^6 paired bootstrap medians with exact Fractions for both baseline/candidate and baseline/baseline-aa. Across 20 two-sided intervals use Bonferroni per-tail probability 1/800. Define each clock's A/A noise floor as max(A/A upper,1/A/A lower), which must be <=51/50. geometry_supported requires the primary device median >=51/50 and its A/B lower endpoint strictly greater than that primary A/A noise floor, plus A/B median and lower >=50/51 for complete_ms on all five cells and device_ms on all four non-primary cells. A failed A/A containment or resolution gate makes clocks invalid_measurement and every exported measured wall_valid false; otherwise any failed A/B timing gate yields geometry_not_supported. The controller-side finalizer then applies incomplete_session before invalid_measurement before the two timing outcomes.
decision_rule.threshold: all ten A/A intervals contain 1 and lie within [50/51,51/50]; primary device A/B median >=51/50 and lower > max(A/A upper,1/A/A lower); nine non-regression A/B medians and lower bounds >=50/51
decision_rule.statistic: for each same-round triple, baseline/candidate and baseline/baseline-aa ratios; exact median of six pair ratios
decision_rule.interval: twenty exact two-sided paired-bootstrap median intervals over all 6^6 resamples; 40 Bonferroni tails at exact rational probability 1/800; no RNG, interpolation, Monte Carlo, or asymptotic approximation
decision_rule.effect_size_measure: paired baseline/candidate speedup read against symmetric same-session baseline/baseline-aa clock noise
